model_key.trailing: reference: player's trailing DK points per game (no opportunity model)
model_key.none_uncal: reference: opportunity model without league calibration
model_key.role_uncal: reference: role model without league calibration (shows the calibration artifact)
model_key.none: MODEL A - calibrated opportunity model, offense/player expectation only, no defense
model_key.role_matchup: MODEL C - B + defense receiving-efficiency (DK per target allowed)
model_key.script_none: Vegas/game-script role terms only, no defense (isolates D's Vegas part)
model_key.script_role_matchup: MODEL D - C + Vegas/game-script role terms
